**TypeAssist 1.6.3**: offline autocorrect and word prediction for **Persian and English** in every Windows app.

### Fixed
- **Words disappearing or getting jumbled when typing fast.** When TypeAssist fixed a word, letters you typed right after it could land in the middle of the fix, so its Backspaces deleted the wrong letters. Keys typed while a fix is in progress are now held back for a moment and passed on right after it, in their original order.
- **Correct words replaced with nonsense from the other language.** If Windows doesn't report the keyboard language correctly, a correct word could be read in the wrong language and "corrected". A typo fix is now skipped whenever the same keys spell a common word on another installed keyboard.
- In apps that ignore keyboard switching, TypeAssist goes back to the keyboard Windows reports instead of keeping its own guess.
- The keyboard hook no longer writes the log to disk itself, so it stays fast.

### Upgrading
1. Right-click the tray icon → **Exit**. If you see "TypeAssist is already running" when starting the new one, the old one is still active.
2. Download `TypeAssist-1.6.3.zip` below; before extracting, right-click → Properties → tick **Unblock**.
3. Run `TypeAssist.exe` and check the version under **About TypeAssist…**.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mkovich/TypeAssist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
